        return;

    if (visitedDP[tStep][x][y][x0][y0])

    if (timeMap[x][y] != 0 && tStep > timeMap[x][y])
        return;
    if (timeMap[x][y] == tStep && (gridB[x][y] > '9' || gridB[x][y] <= '0'))
        return;
    visitedDP[tStep][x][y][x0][y0] = true;

    if (tStep < timeMap[x][y]) {
        exploreDP(tStep + 1, x, y, x0, y0);
        exploreDP(tStep + 1, x + 1, y, x0, y0);
        exploreDP(tStep + 1, x - 1, y, x0, y0);
        exploreDP(tStep + 1, x, y + 1, x0, y0);
        exploreDP(tStep + 1, x, y - 1, x0, y0);
    }
}

        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)

    int pN[11][11] = {0};

    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            timeMap[i][j] = -1;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                timeMap[i][j] = 0;
                q.push({i, j});

        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            if (timeMap[i][j] == -1)
                timeMap[i][j] = t;

        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            if (gridA[i][j] >= '0' && gridA[i][j] <= '9')

                    for (int nt = 0; nt <= t; nt++)
                        reachable[i1][j1][i2][j2] |= visitedDP[nt][i1][j1][i2][j2];

        for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++)
            if (gridA[i1][j1] > '0' && gridA[i1][j1] <= '9') {
                int k = graph.size();
                vector<int> g;
                graph.push_back(g);
                E[k] = gridA[i1][j1] - '0';

                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++)
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++)
                        if (gridB[i2][j2] > '0' && gridB[i2][j2] <= '9')
                            if (reachable[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                int _k;
                                if (pN[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                    vector<int> _g;
                                    _k = graph.size();
                                    graph.push_back(_g);
                                    pN[i2][j2] = _k;
                                } else {
                                    _k = pN[i2][j2];
                                }
                                graph[k].push_back(_k);
                                graph[_k].push_back(k);
                                C[k][_k] = 10000;
                                C[_k][k] = 0;
                            }
            }

    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++)
        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++)
            if (gridB[i2][j2] > '0' && gridB[i2][j2] <= '9' && pN[i2][j2] > 0) {
                int _k = pN[i2][j2];
                graph[_k].push_back(0);
                C[_k][0] = gridB[i2][j2] - '0';
                C[0][_k] = 0;
            }

        bool allDone = true;
        for (int i = 1; i < (int)graph.size(); i++) {

                    H[i] = minH + 1;

            }
        }
